SIKAGROUT®-9850: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaGrout®-9850, October 2025, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sikagrout-9850.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaGrout®-9850 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaGrout®-9850 is a ready-to-use, silo-based cementitious grout that forms a flowable, cohesive, and impermeable ultra-high performance cementitious (UHPC) grout when mixed with water. SikaGrout®-9850 develops high compressive strength rapidly, even in low temperatures, and is ideal for narrow constrictions and offshore wind foundation systems. With excellent flowability, anti-washout properties, low water permeability, and high resistance to aggressive ions, it also offers structural corrosion protection and flexibility in installation methods.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaGrout®-9850 has been especially formulated for large scale, pump applications.
    - Grouting of grouted connections in offshore installations, e.g. foundations of wind turbines or oil & gas installations.
    - Typical applications are pile-sleeve and stab-in-pile grouted connections, clamp repair, leg filling etc…
    - Grouting under very harsh conditions, e.g. offshore pplications or below water grouting, at temperatures as low as 0°C or up to 40°C.
    - All void filling from 25 mm to 700mm thickness where high strength is important.
    Contact the Technical Department of your local Sika office regarding any application or dimensions required not mentioned here.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaGrout®-9850
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Ultra-high performance cementitious (UHPC), flowable grout with advanced technology for rapid strength development in offshore wind installations
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. DNV Type Approval Certificate no. TAK00001ZB
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 12390-7: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Density (p.2).
    - EN 12190: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - EN 12390-13: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - ASTM C469: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - EN 1015-11: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Flexural-strength (p.2).
    - ASTM C1698: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Expansion (p.2).
    - ASTM C882: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shear adhesion strength (p.2).
    - EN 12390-6: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Splitting tensile strength (p.2).
    - ASTM C1202: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Chloride ion permeability (p.2).
    - ASTM C1437: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Flowability (p.3).
    - EN 12350-8: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Flowability (p.3).
    - EN 206: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Flowability (p.3).
    - EN 196-3: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Setting time (p.3).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Quick return to service and removal of temporary supports due to high early strength build-up. ≥ 50 MPa @ 24hrs at 20°C.
    - High early strength at low temperatures.
    - No segregation or bleeding to ensure consistent physical performance inside the grouted connection, and to prevent pump blockages.
    - Excellent fatigue resistance
    - No wash-out during below water grouting.
    - Pump able over long distances and large heights.
    - Available as silo material
    - Excellent flowability
    - Shrinkage compensated
2.5 Density.
    | Temperature | ton/m³ |
    | at 20 oC | 2.28 - 2.33 |
    | at low temperatures < 3 oC | 2-25 - 2.28 |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN 12390-7)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: 41.000 N/mm²; Poisson ratio: 0.20 (EN 12390-13) (ASTM C469)
    - Flexural-strength: 16.5 N/mm² (EN 1015-11)
    - Splitting tensile strength: 8.0 N/mm² (EN 12390-6)
    - Chloride ion permeability: < 200 (very low penetrability) (ASTM C1202)

2.8 Expansion.
    | 0.1% (net expansion) | at 56 days |

2.9 Shear adhesion strength.

2.10 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: SikaGrout®-9850 is supplied in special 25 kg bags and 500, 1000, 1500 kg big bags
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
2.11 Storage conditions. Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions away from direct sunlight and heat, within 5 to 40 o C. When stored under extreme low or high temperatures, and high humidity conditions, the shelf life may be reduced.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2025, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Approximately 12.4 – 13.6 % water / powder ratio
    - Consumption: Approximately 500 liters per ton material
    - Pot Life: 2 hours
4.3 Layer thickness. 25 - 700 mm
    | Minimum | 25 mm (valid for anchor cage grout- |
    | ing) |
    | 40 mm (valid for annuluses in tubular / conical grouted connections) |
    | Maximum | 700 mm |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Flowability. Flow table
    | at 20 oC | 360 - 390 mm |
    | low temperatures < 3 oC | 300 - 330 mm |
    | Slump flow |
    | by Abraham cone | ≥ 760 mm |
    | Slump flow class | SF3 |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (ASTM C1437)
    Test method printed: (EN 12350-8)
    Test method printed: (EN 206)
4.5 Setting time.
    | Initial | Final | Temperature |
    | 4.5 - 5.5 hours | 5 - 6 hours | 20 oC |
    Test method printed: (EN 196-3)
4.6 Notes on installation.
    - SikaGrout®-9850 has been especially formulated for use in specific applications. As such SikaGrout®-9850 should be installed by experienced fully trained contractors. Full application procedures are available on request.
    - The temperature of walls and spaces where the grout is to be pumped should be between 5ºC and 35ºC for optimum results. If application temperature is outside of above range, contact the Technical Department of your local Sika office for technical support.
    - Sands or other products that could affect the products properties must not be added.
4.7 Equipment.
    | Mixer type | Paddle mixer |
    | Mixing time | Approximately 6 minutes |
    | Application method | One continuous pour |
4.8 Mixing. SikaGrout®-9850 must be mixed using suitable grout mixing equipment combined with agitator for continuous large volume mixing. Volume capacity of equipment must be applicable to the volume of material being mixed for a continuous operation. Equipment trials must be considered to ensure product can be mixed satisfactory before full project application. Put most of the water required in the mixer and add slowly the grout material. Mix until a homogeneous mortar (3 to 4 minutes), add the remaining water and continue mixing for at least another 2 minutes until the required fluid or flowable consistency is obtained. Mix with potable water only. Do not add more water than the maximum specified.
4.9 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and spillages can be cleaned with water while SikaGrout®-9850 is still uncured. Once hardened, the material can only be removed mechanically.
4.10 Further documentation. Sika Method Statement: SikaGrout®-9850

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature. 0 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.3 Ambient air temperature. 0 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.4 Substrate temperature. 0 °C min. / +40 °C max.
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: Temperature | ton/m³; at 20 oC | 2.28 - 2.33; at low temperatures < 3 oC | 2-25 - 2.28 (EN 12390-7)
    - Compressive strength: Age | N/mm²; 1 day | ≥ 50; 3 days | ≥ 70; 7 days | ≥ 90; 28 days | ≥ 125; 50 mm cubes, at 20 oC; Age | N/mm²; 1 day | ≥ 50; 3 days | ≥ 70; 7 days | ≥ 85; 28 days | ≥ 120; 150 x 300 mm cylinders, at 20 oC (ASTM C109/C109M) (EN 12190)
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: 41.000 N/mm²; Poisson ratio: 0.20 (EN 12390-13) (ASTM C469)
    - Flexural-strength: 16.5 N/mm² (EN 1015-11)
    - Expansion: 0.1% (net expansion) | at 56 days (ASTM C1698)
    - Shear adhesion strength: Age | N/mm²; 14 days | 40.0 (ASTM C882)
    - Splitting tensile strength: 8.0 N/mm² (EN 12390-6)
    - Chloride ion permeability: < 200 (very low penetrability) (ASTM C1202)
    - Flowability: at 20 oC | 360 - 390 mm; low temperatures < 3 oC | 300 - 330 mm; Slump flow; by Abraham cone | ≥ 760 mm; Slump flow class | SF3; Flow table (ASTM C1437) (EN 12350-8) (EN 206)
    - Setting time: Initial | Final | Temperature; 4.5 - 5.5 hours | 5 - 6 hours | 20 oC (EN 196-3)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaGrout®-9850, October 2025, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sikagrout-9850.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaGrout - 9850, version 08/10/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/SDS%20SikaGrout%20-%209850%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
